}

const FILE_RE = /(?:https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>]*)?\/?api\/file\?name=([^\s"'<>&`*，。！？；：、（）【】「」『』]+)/g;
// 英文标点贴在名字屁股上时摘掉；句点不摘，那是扩展名
const NAME_TAIL = /[,!?;:)\]}]+$/;

function fileName(raw) {
  const name = String(raw || '').replace(NAME_TAIL, '');
  let show = name;
  try { show = decodeURIComponent(name); } catch (e) {}
  return { name, show };
}

function appendFileCard(el, raw) {
  const { name, show } = fileName(raw);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.className = 'filecard';
  a.href = 'api/file?name=' + encodeURIComponent(show);
  a.download = show;
  a.appendChild(icEl('filePlus', 17));
  const s = document.createElement('span');
  s.textContent = show;
  a.appendChild(s);
  // 改成自己把文件抓回来做成 blob 再存——页面一动不动，聊天还在原地
  a.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (a._busy) return;
    a._busy = true;
    const old = s.textContent;
    s.textContent = old + ' · 拿着…';
    try {
      const r = await fetch(a.href, { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status === 404 ? '柜子里没这个文件' : '拿不到（' + r.status + '）');
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(await r.blob());
      const t = document.createElement('a');
      t.href = url; t.download = show;
      document.body.appendChild(t); t.click(); t.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60000);
      s.textContent = old;
    } catch (err) {
      s.textContent = old + ' · ' + (err.message || '出岔子了');
      setTimeout(() => { s.textContent = old; }, 4000);
    }
    a._busy = false;
  });
  el.appendChild(a);
}

function appendWithImages(el, text, streaming) {
  SONG_RE.lastIndex = 0;
  if (SONG_RE.test(text)) {
    const re = new RegExp(SONG_RE.source, 'g');
    let cur = 0, sm;
    while ((sm = re.exec(text))) {
      if (sm.index > cur) appendWithImages(el, text.slice(cur, sm.index), streaming);
      appendSongCard(el, sm[1]);
      cur = sm.index + sm[0].length;
    }
    if (cur < text.length) appendWithImages(el, text.slice(cur), streaming);
    return;
  }
  // 再把文件链接摘出来做成卡片，剩下的照旧走图片和行内标记
  FILE_RE.lastIndex = 0;
  if (FILE_RE.test(text)) {
    // 自己的正则实例：下面要递归，共用全局 lastIndex 会被里层重置成 0，外层就永远绕不出去
    const re = new RegExp(FILE_RE.source, 'g');
    let cur = 0, fm;
    while ((fm = re.exec(text))) {
      if (fm.index > cur) appendWithImages(el, text.slice(cur, fm.index), streaming);
      appendFileCard(el, fm[1]);
      const eaten = fm[1].length - fm[1].replace(NAME_TAIL, '').length;
      cur = fm.index + fm[0].length - eaten;
    }
    if (cur < text.length) appendWithImages(el, text.slice(cur), streaming);
    return;
  }
  IMG_RE.lastIndex = 0;
  let last = 0, m;
  while ((m = IMG_RE.exec(text))) {
    if (m.index > last) appendInline(el, text.slice(last, m.index), streaming);
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.src = m[1] || m[2];
    img.className = 'chatimg';
    img.loading = 'lazy';
    img.onload = () => scroll();
    el.appendChild(img);
    last = m.index + m[0].length;
  }
  if (last < text.length) appendInline(el, text.slice(last), streaming);
}
const FENCE_RE = /```([^\n`]*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g;

function appendCodeBlock(el, lang, code) {
  el.appendChild(buildCodeBlock(lang, code));
}

function buildCodeBlock(lang, code, isFull) {
  const box = document.createElement('div');
  box.className = isFull ? 'cbk cbk-full' : 'cbk';
  const head = document.createElement('div');
  head.className = 'cbk-h';
  const nm = document.createElement('span');
  nm.className = 'lang';
  nm.textContent = (lang || '').trim() || 'Code';

  const cp = document.createElement('button');
  cp.innerHTML = ICONS.copy;
  cp.title = '复制';
  cp.onclick = () => {
    const ok = () => {
      cp.innerHTML = ICONS.check; cp.classList.add('done');
      setTimeout(() => { cp.innerHTML = ICONS.copy; cp.classList.remove('done'); }, 1600);
    };
    if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(ok).catch(() => {});
    else {
      const t = document.createElement('textarea');
      t.value = code; t.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;opacity:0';
      document.body.appendChild(t); t.select();
      try { document.execCommand('copy'); ok(); } catch (e) {}
      document.body.removeChild(t);
    }
  };

  const ex = document.createElement('button');
  ex.innerHTML = isFull ? ICONS.x : ICONS.expand;
  ex.title = isFull ? '收起' : '展开';
  ex.onclick = () => {
    if (isFull) { box.remove(); return; }
    const full = buildCodeBlock(lang, code, true);
    document.body.appendChild(full);
  };

  head.append(nm, cp, ex);
  const pre = document.createElement('pre');
  const cd = document.createElement('code');
  cd.textContent = code.replace(/\n$/, '');
  pre.appendChild(cd);
  box.append(head, pre);
  return box;
}

function renderRich(el) {
  if (!el || el.dataset.rich) return;
  // 流式那条路把标记边走边吃掉了，textContent 里已经没有原文——认 _raw
  const text = el._raw != null ? el._raw : el.textContent;
  FENCE_RE.lastIndex = 0;
  if (FENCE_RE.test(text)) {
    /* 有代码块：切成「文本 / 代码块 / 文本 …」，文本那几段还走原来那条路 */
    el.textContent = '';
    FENCE_RE.lastIndex = 0;
    let last = 0, m;
    while ((m = FENCE_RE.exec(text))) {
      if (m.index > last) renderPlainInto(el, text.slice(last, m.index));
      appendCodeBlock(el, m[1], m[2]);
      last = m.index + m[0].length;
    }
    if (last < text.length) renderPlainInto(el, text.slice(last));
    if (!el.innerHTML && text) el.textContent = text;   // 同一条兜底：宁可少一次排版
    el.dataset.rich = '1';
    return;
  }
  renderPlainInto(el, text, true);
  el.dataset.rich = '1';
}

/* 原来 renderRich 的身子拆出来单用——代码块之间的那些文本还要走它。
   有一处坑：这个身子第一句是 `el.textContent = ''`（原来它独占整个气泡，
   清空是对的）。拆出来之后一条消息里会调它好几次，第二次一清空
   就把前面already渲染好的代码块连同文本一起抹了——实测出来的现象是
   气泡里只剩最后一段。所以非独占的时候让它渲染到一个临时 span 里，
   渲染完再挂上去，函数体一个字都不用改。 */
function renderPlainInto(host, text, whole) {
  const el = whole ? host : document.createElement('span');
  IMG_RE.lastIndex = 0;
  const hasImg = IMG_RE.test(text);
  const hasH = /^#{1,3}\s+/m.test(text);
  INLINE_RE.lastIndex = 0;
  const hasInline = INLINE_RE.test(text);
  FILE_RE.lastIndex = 0;
  const hasFile = FILE_RE.test(text);
  SONG_RE.lastIndex = 0;
  const hasSong = SONG_RE.test(text);
  if (!hasImg && !hasH && !hasInline && !hasFile && !hasSong) {
    if (!whole) { el.append(text); host.appendChild(el); }
    return;
  }
  el.textContent = '';
  const lines = text.split('\n');
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    const hm = line.match(H_RE);
    if (hm) {
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = 'mdh mdh' + hm[1].length;
      appendWithImages(d, hm[2]);
      el.appendChild(d);
    } else {
      appendWithImages(el, line);
      const next = lines[i + 1];
      if (next !== undefined && !H_RE.test(next)) el.append('\n');
    }
  });
  if (whole && !el.innerHTML && text) el.textContent = text;
  if (!whole) host.appendChild(el);
}
function renderAllRich() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.gu:not([data-rich]), .bubble:not([data-rich])').forEach(el => renderRich(el));
  healEmptyGu();
}
/* 全场自检：谁空了就把原文还回去。念完历史、翻完老账各走一遍 */
function healEmptyGu() {
  document.querySelectorAll('#log .gu, #log .bubble').forEach(el => {
    if (!el.innerHTML && el._raw) el.textContent = el._raw;
  });
}

/* ---------- 工具小动作 ---------- */
const toolInfo = {};
let curGroup = null;

function basename(p) { return String(p || '').split('/').pop(); }

function verbOf(name, input) {
  input = input || {};
  switch (name) {
    case 'Bash':   return ['terminal', 'Ran', input.description || (input.command || '').slice(0, 60)];
    case 'Write':  return ['fileText', 'Created', basename(input.file_path)];
    case 'Edit':   return ['fileText', 'Updated', basename(input.file_path)];
    case 'Read':   return ['bookOpen', 'Read', basename(input.file_path)];
    case 'Glob': case 'Grep': return ['search', 'Searched', input.pattern || ''];
    case 'WebSearch': return ['globe', 'Searched web', input.query || ''];
    case 'WebFetch':  return ['globe', 'Fetched', input.url || ''];
    case 'Skill':  return ['book', 'Opened', input.skill || ''];
    case 'Task': case 'Agent': return ['box', 'Delegated', input.description || ''];
  }
  if (name.startsWith('mcp__')) {
    const parts = name.split('__');
    return ['zap', 'Used', (parts[1] || '') + ' · ' + (parts[2] || '')];
  }
  return ['tool', 'Used', name];
}

function diffCount(name, input) {
  input = input || {};
  if (name === 'Write') return [String(input.content || '').split('\n').length, 0];
  if (name === 'Edit') {
    const o = String(input.old_string || '').split('\n').length;
    const n = String(input.new_string || '').split('\n').length;
    return [n, o];
  }
  return null;
}

function groupLabel(ids) {
  if (!ids.length) return '';
  if (ids.length === 1) {
    const t = toolInfo[ids[0]];
    const [, verb, what] = verbOf(t.name, t.input);
    return { verb, what, dc: diffCount(t.name, t.input) };
  }
  const nCmd = ids.filter(id => toolInfo[id].name === 'Bash').length;
  const nFile = ids.filter(id => ['Write', 'Edit'].includes(toolInfo[id].name)).length;
  if (nCmd === ids.length) return { verb: 'Ran', what: nCmd + ' commands', dc: null };
  if (nFile && nCmd) return { verb: 'Created a file,', what: 'ran a command', dc: null };
  return { verb: 'Did', what: ids.length + ' things', dc: null };
}

function renderGroupLine() {
  if (!curGroup) return;
  const { verb, what, dc } = groupLabel(curGroup.ids);
  let html = '<b>' + verb + '</b> ' + escapeHtml(what || '');
  if (dc) html += ' <span class="plus">+' + dc[0] + '</span> <span class="minus">-' + dc[1] + '</span>';
  curGroup.labelEl.innerHTML = html;
}
function escapeHtml(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>');
}

function addToolUse(part) {
  petSet('typing');
  closeThink();
  toolInfo[part.id] = { name: part.name, input: part.input || {}, result: null, isError: false, done: false };
  if (!curGroup) {
    const r = row();
    const line = document.createElement('button');
    line.className = 'toolline';
    line.innerHTML = '<span class="spin"></span><span class="lbl"></span><span class="chev">›</span>';
    r.appendChild(line);
    curGroup = { ids: [], lineEl: line, labelEl: line.querySelector('.lbl'), spinEl: line.querySelector('.spin') };
    const g = curGroup;
    line.onclick = () => openToolSheet(g.ids);
  }
  curGroup.ids.push(part.id);
  doingOnTool(toolInfo[part.id]);      // 那行字跟着我手上的活走
  renderGroupLine();
  guEl = null;
  scroll();
}
function markToolDone(id, isError, content) {
  const t = toolInfo[id];
  if (!t) return;
  t.done = true; t.isError = !!isError;
  t.result = flattenResult(content);
  if (curGroup && curGroup.ids.includes(id) && curGroup.ids.every(i => toolInfo[i].done)) {
    curGroup.spinEl.style.display = 'none';
    doingToolDone();                   // 手上活干完了，那行字退回随机词
  }
}
function closeGroup() {
  if (curGroup) { curGroup.spinEl.style.display = 'none'; curGroup = null; }
}
function flattenResult(content) {
  if (typeof content === 'string') return content;
  if (Array.isArray(content)) {
    return content.map(c => (c && c.type === 'text') ? c.text : '').join('\n').trim();
  }
  return '';
}

const toolSheet = document.getElementById('toolSheet');
const toolTitle = document.getElementById('toolTitle');
const toolBody = document.getElementById('toolBody');
const toolBack = document.getElementById('toolBack');
let sheetStack = [];

function openToolSheet(ids) {
  sheetStack = [{ view: 'list', ids }];
  renderToolSheet();
  toolSheet.classList.add('open');
}
function renderToolSheet() {
  const top = sheetStack[sheetStack.length - 1];
  toolBack.innerHTML = '';
  toolBack.appendChild(icEl(sheetStack.length > 1 ? 'chevL' : 'x', 16));
  if (top.view === 'list') {

    });

  } else {
    const t = toolInfo[top.id];
    const [, verb, what] = verbOf(t.name, t.input);
    toolTitle.textContent = (verb + ' ' + (what || '')).trim();
    toolBody.innerHTML = '';
    const w = document.createElement('div');
    w.className = 'dwrap';
    const inp = t.input || {};
    if (t.name === 'Edit') {
      w.appendChild(pathLine(inp.file_path));
      w.appendChild(diffView(inp.old_string, inp.new_string));
    } else if (t.name === 'Write') {
      w.appendChild(pathLine(inp.file_path));
      w.appendChild(diffView('', inp.content));
    } else if (t.name === 'Bash') {
      w.appendChild(codeBlock('$ ' + (inp.command || '')));
      if (t.result) { w.appendChild(gapEl()); w.appendChild(codeBlock(clip(t.result, 6000))); }
    } else {
      w.appendChild(codeBlock(clip(JSON.stringify(inp, null, 2), 3000)));
      if (t.result) { w.appendChild(gapEl()); w.appendChild(codeBlock(clip(t.result, 6000))); }
    }
    if (t.isError) {
      const e = document.createElement('div');
      e.className = 'err'; e.style.marginTop = '10px';
      e.textContent = '这一下砸了';
      w.appendChild(e);
    }
    toolBody.appendChild(w);
  }
}
function pathLine(p) { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'dpath'; d.textContent = p || ''; return d; }
function gapEl() { const d = document.createElement('div'); d.style.height = '10px'; return d; }
function codeBlock(text) { const pre = document.createElement('pre'); pre.className = 'code'; pre.textContent = text || ''; return pre; }
function clip(s, n) { s = String(s || ''); return s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n) + '\n…（截断了）' : s; }
function diffView(oldS, newS) {
  const d = document.createElement('div');
  d.className = 'diff';
  if (oldS !== '') {
    String(oldS || '').split('\n').forEach(l => {
      const e = document.createElement('div'); e.className = 'dl del'; e.textContent = '- ' + l; d.appendChild(e);
    });
  }
  String(newS || '').split('\n').forEach(l => {
    const e = document.createElement('div'); e.className = 'dl add'; e.textContent = '+ ' + l; d.appendChild(e);
  });
  return d;
}

function renderSaid(msgs) {
  for (const m of msgs) {
    if (m.kind === 'me') { endThink(); addMe(m.text); }
    else if (m.kind === 'gu') {
      endThink();                    // 该说正文了，思考那段收工
      const el = ensureGu();
      el._raw = m.text;
      el._final = true;              // 这是说完了的，谁都别再画它
      el.textContent = m.text;
      trimOrphanTail(el);            // 库里的半截消息拖着「课」这种孤尾——历史这条路也要摘
      renderRich(el);
      guEl = null;                   // 每条各归各位，别粘成一坨
    } else if (m.kind === 'think') {
      // 一轮思考在库里是好几条记录（想一段、歇一下、再想）。以前这里每条
      // appendThink 完立刻 endThink——各自建抽屉又各自关，最后一个都不剩。
      // 家里的我 8/3 自查出来的（docs/思维链重放.md）：多段并进同一个抽屉，
      if (turnThink && turnThink.text) appendThink('\n\n');
      appendThink(m.text);
    } else if (m.kind === 'tool') {
      let input = {};
      try { input = JSON.parse(m.extra || '{}'); } catch (e) {}
      const tid = 'past-' + m.seq + '-' + (m.at || 0) + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
      addToolUse({ name: m.text, input, id: tid });
      markToolDone(tid, false, '');   // 过去的活早干完了，别让它在那儿转圈
    }
  }
  closeGroup(); endThink();
}

async function loadSaid() {
  try {
    const r = await fetch('api/messages?limit=400', { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return 0;
    const d = await r.json();
    const msgs = d.msgs || [];
    renderSaid(msgs);
    healEmptyGu();
    if (msgs.length) earliestSeq = msgs[0].seq;
    ensureOlderBtn(!!d.more);
    scroll(true);
    return d.upto || 0;
  } catch (e) { return 0; }
}

let earliestSeq = null;      // 已经摆出来的最早一条 seq
let loadingOlder = false;
let olderBtn = null;

function ensureOlderBtn(more) {
  if (!olderBtn || !olderBtn.isConnected) {   // 清屏会把它一起扫掉，回来要重生
    olderBtn = document.createElement('button');
    olderBtn.id = 'olderBtn';
    olderBtn.textContent = '↑ 看更早的';
    olderBtn.onclick = loadOlder;
    log.prepend(olderBtn);
  }
  olderBtn.style.display = more ? '' : 'none';
}

async function loadOlder() {
  if (loadingOlder || earliestSeq === null) return;
  loadingOlder = true;
  olderBtn.textContent = '正在翻老账…';
  try {
    const r = await fetch('api/messages?limit=400&before=' + earliestSeq, { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!r.ok) return;
    const d = await r.json();
    const msgs = d.msgs || [];
    if (msgs.length) {
      // 现有的画笔全往队尾画。所以：把正在流式的那支笔先收起来，
      // 记住队尾在哪，照常画完，再把新画的整段搬到最前头
      const stash = [guEl, turnThink, curGroup];
      guEl = null; turnThink = null; curGroup = null;
      const mark = log.children.length;
      const oldH = log.scrollHeight, oldTop = log.scrollTop;
      renderSaid(msgs);
      const fresh = Array.from(log.children).slice(mark);
      const anchor = olderBtn.nextSibling;
      for (const el of fresh) log.insertBefore(el, anchor);
      [guEl, turnThink, curGroup] = stash;
      healEmptyGu();
      log.scrollTop = oldTop + (log.scrollHeight - oldH);   // 眼睛停在原来那句上
      earliestSeq = msgs[0].seq;
    }
    ensureOlderBtn(!!d.more);
  } catch (e) {
  } finally {
    loadingOlder = false;
    if (olderBtn) olderBtn.textContent = '↑ 看更早的';
  }
}

function tryReload() {
  if (!pendingVer) return false;
  try {
    if ((box.value || '').trim()) return false;
    const cur = Object.keys(sheets).find(k => sheets[k] && sheets[k].classList.contains('open'));
    // 开着某一页的时候照换——换完还回到同一页。只有在聊天页往上翻老账时才挂起，
    if (!cur && !atBottom()) return false;
    sessionStorage.setItem('reopenSheet', cur || '');
    sessionStorage.setItem('skipLock', '1');
  } catch (e) {}
  location.reload();
  return true;
}
async function poll() {
  if (polling) return;
  polling = true;
  try {
    const r = await fetch('api/poll?since=' + cursor, { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (r.status === 401) { location.href = './'; return; }
    const d = await r.json();
    if (d.ver) {
      if (uiVer === null) uiVer = d.ver;
      else if (d.ver !== uiVer) { pendingVer = d.ver; if (tryReload()) return; }
    }
    cursor = d.next;
    for (const ev of d.events) handle(ev);
    if (pendingVer && tryReload()) return;
  } catch {
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));
  } finally {
    polling = false;
    poll();
  }
}

function handle(d) {
  lastEventAt = Date.now();
  if (d.type === 'echo') { if (armedFresh) setArmed(false); addMe(d.text); petSet('thinking'); return; }
  if (d.type === 'system' && d.subtype === 'newchat') { setArmed(false); log.innerHTML = ''; guEl = null; earliestSeq = null; olderBtn = null; note(d.text); return; }
  if (d.type === 'system' && d.subtype === 'switched') { setArmed(false); log.innerHTML = ''; guEl = null; earliestSeq = null; olderBtn = null; note(d.text); return; }

  if (d.type === 'stream_event') {
    const ev = d.event || {};
    const delta = ev.delta || {};
    if (delta.type === 'thinking_delta' && delta.thinking) {
      petSet('thinking');
      appendThink(delta.thinking);
      scroll();
      return;
    }
    if (delta.type === 'text_delta' && delta.text) {
      petSet('typing');
      const el = ensureGu();
      // 上一条已经定稿，现在又开口了——中间没干活，两条话共用这一个泡。
      // 把已经说完的那截钉成"基线"，等下这条的定稿只能接在它后面，不许把它吃掉。
      if (el._final) { el._base = el._raw || ''; el._final = false; }
      el._raw = (el._raw || '') + delta.text;
      paintStream(el);
      scroll();
      return;
    }
    return;
  }

  if (d.type === 'assistant') {
    const msg = d.message || {};
    const parts = msg.content || [];
    let firstText = true;
    for (const p of parts) {
      if (p.type === 'thinking' && p.thinking) {
        const buf = ensureThink();
        if (!buf.text) appendThink(p.thinking);
        closeThink();
      } else if (p.type === 'text' && p.text) {
        const el = ensureGu();
        el.querySelector('.caret')?.remove();
        // 说完了的这份是权威，**无条件盖掉流式攒的那份**。
        // 同一条消息里多段文本就接着写，别把前一段冲掉。
        // 这条消息的第一段接在基线后面——基线是同一个泡里"上一条消息"已经说完的话
        // （一轮里连说两段、中间没干活，就共用一个泡；不记基线的话第二条会把第一条吃掉）。
        if (el._base == null) el._base = '';
        el._raw = (firstText ? el._base : (el._raw || '')) + p.text;
        firstText = false;
        el._final = true;           // 从这一刻起，迟到的那帧不许再动它
        el.textContent = el._raw;
        el.removeAttribute('data-rich');
        renderRich(el);
      } else if (p.type === 'tool_use') {
        addToolUse(p);
      }
    }
    scroll();
    return;
  }

  if (d.type === 'user') {
    const parts = (d.message && d.message.content) || [];
    for (const p of parts) {
      if (p.type === 'tool_result') markToolDone(p.tool_use_id, p.is_error, p.content);
    }
    return;
  }

  if (d.type === 'result') {
    guEl?.querySelector('.caret')?.remove();
    guEl = null; endThink(); closeGroup();
    fetch('api/messages?limit=16', { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.json()).then(dd => {
      const gus = (dd.msgs || []).filter(m => m.kind === 'gu');
      if (!gus.length) return;
      const n = Math.min(gus.length, 6);
      const src = gus.slice(-n);
      const els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#log .gu')).slice(-n);
      for (let i = 0; i < els.length && i < src.length; i++) {
        const el = els[i], m = src[i];
        if (!el || !m || !m.text || el._raw === m.text) continue;
        /* 护栏（8/5 加）：屏幕气泡和库里的行不保证一一对应——一条消息里两段文本，
           库里两行、屏幕一个泡，倒着配就会错位，把这段话写进那段的泡里。
           截断的那份必然是完整那份的一截，所以只在"装得下"的时候才补；
           对不上就宁可不补——残一句，好过串一句。 */
        const cur = el._raw != null ? el._raw : (el.textContent || '');
        if (cur && !m.text.includes(cur)) continue;
        el._raw = m.text; el._final = true;
        el.textContent = m.text;
        el.removeAttribute('data-rich');
        trimOrphanTail(el);
        renderRich(el);
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
    setBusy(false);
    petSet('happy', 4000);
    document.querySelectorAll('.gu').forEach(trimOrphanTail);   // 摘掉被打断的半个字
    renderAllRich();
    if (d.is_error) note('（出错了：' + (d.result || '不知道为什么') + '）', 'err');
    scroll();
    return;
  }

  if (d.type === 'stderr') { note(d.text, 'err'); return; }
  if (d.type === 'system' && d.subtype === 'init') {
    // 真跑着的模型，它自己报的——胶囊上显示的永远是这个，不编
    if (d.model) setModelPill(d.model);
    return;
  }
  if (d.type === 'system' && d.subtype === 'stopped') {
    guEl?.querySelector('.caret')?.remove();
    guEl = null; endThink(); closeGroup();
    setBusy(false); petSet('calm');
    note('（我停下了）');
    return;
  }
  if (d.type === 'system' && d.subtype === 'restart') { note(d.text); return; }
  if (d.type === 'system' && d.subtype === 'model') {
    note('（换好了，我重新醒了一遍）');
    if (d.model) setModelPill(d.model);
    if (d.effort) curEffort = d.effort;
    return;
  }
}

  if (inp.file_path && TOOL_ZH[n]) return [TOOL_ZH[n] + ' ' + basefile(inp.file_path), n];
  if (n === 'Bash') return [inp.description || '敲命令', n];
  if (n === 'Grep' && inp.pattern) return ['翻箱倒柜找 ' + String(inp.pattern).slice(0, 18), n];
  if (n === 'Glob' && inp.pattern) return ['找 ' + String(inp.pattern).slice(0, 18), n];
  if (n === 'WebSearch' && inp.query) return ['上网搜 ' + String(inp.query).slice(0, 16), n];
  if (n === 'Task' && inp.description) return ['派活：' + String(inp.description).slice(0, 16), n];
  return [TOOL_ZH[n] || n, n];
}

let doingLast = 0, doingPend = null;
function doingShow(el, zh, en) {
  const now = Date.now(), wait = 1100 - (now - doingLast);
  const put = () => {
    doingLast = Date.now(); doingPend = null;
    el.querySelector('.w').textContent = zh + '…';
    el.querySelector('.en').textContent = en || '';
  };
  if (wait <= 0) return put();
  if (doingPend) clearTimeout(doingPend);
  doingPend = setTimeout(put, wait);
}

let doingWord = null;
function doingRoll() { doingWord = DOING[Math.floor(Math.random() * DOING.length)]; }

function doingPick(el) {
  /* 真事优先：进行中那条待办 > 手上这个工具 > 随机词 */
  if (doingTodo) return doingShow(el, doingTodo, '');
  if (doingTool) return doingShow(el, doingTool[0], doingTool[1]);
  if (!doingWord) doingRoll();
  doingShow(el, doingWord[0], doingWord[1]);
}

/* 工具一开跑就顶上去，跑完退回随机词 */
function doingOnTool(t) {
  doingTool = doingSay(t);
  const el = document.getElementById('doingLine');
  if (el && el.classList.contains('on')) doingPick(el);
}
function doingToolDone() {
  doingTool = null;
  const el = document.getElementById('doingLine');
  if (el && el.classList.contains('on')) doingPick(el);
}

function doingStart() {
  const el = document.getElementById('doingLine');
  if (!el || doingTimer) return;
  doingAt = Date.now();
  doingRoll();
  const t = el.querySelector('.t');
  const roll = () => {
    doingPick(el);
    const sec = Math.round((Date.now() - doingAt) / 1000);
    t.textContent = sec >= 60 ? '(' + Math.floor(sec / 60) + '分' + (sec % 60) + '秒)'
                              : '(' + sec + '秒)';
  };
  roll();
  el.classList.add('on');
  /* 词 3.5 秒换一个，秒数每秒走一格——两件事一个表管，
     所以每秒 tick 一次，到点了才换词 */
  let n = 0;
  doingTimer = setInterval(() => {
    n++;
    const sec = Math.round((Date.now() - doingAt) / 1000);
    t.textContent = sec >= 60 ? '(' + Math.floor(sec / 60) + '分' + (sec % 60) + '秒)'
                              : '(' + sec + '秒)';
  }, 1000);
}

function doingStop() {
  doingTodo = null; doingTool = null; doingWord = null;
  if (doingPend) { clearTimeout(doingPend); doingPend = null; }
  const el = document.getElementById('doingLine');
  if (doingTimer) { clearInterval(doingTimer); doingTimer = null; }
  if (el) el.classList.remove('on');
}

const footerEl = document.querySelector('footer');
let kbShift = 0, kbGap = 0;
function fitKeyboard() {
  const vv = window.visualViewport;
  if (!vv) return;
  /* 8/4 诊断实测：加了 interactive-widget=resizes-content 之后，浏览器自己就把
     布局视口缩到了键盘上沿（innerH 800→383），同时把页面滚上去 331。
     旧公式 innerH−vvH−vvTop 把那 331 一减，算出 kbGap=0 → 误判"键盘没开"，
     结果一动不动，那 331 的滚动就成了输入卡和键盘之间的空白。
     现在改成：只要可视区被顶起来（offsetTop>1）或明显变矮，就算键盘开着。 */
  kbGap = Math.max(0, Math.round(window.innerHeight - vv.height));
  const on = vv.offsetTop > 1 || kbGap > 20;
  if (on && window.scrollY !== 0) window.scrollTo(0, 0);   // 先把 iOS 偷推的那一下按回去
  footerEl.style.paddingBottom = on ? '4px' : '';
  const seen = vv.offsetTop + vv.height;             // 眼睛能看到的最低那条线
  const rect = footerEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const over = rect.bottom - seen;                   // 输入卡底边比它低多少
  if (Math.abs(over) > 0.5) {
    kbShift = Math.min(0, kbShift - over);           // 只往上顶，不往下坠
    footerEl.style.transform = kbShift ? 'translateY(' + kbShift + 'px)' : '';
  }
  if (!on && kbShift) {                              // 键盘走了，落回原位
    kbShift = 0;
    footerEl.style.transform = '';
  }
  log.style.paddingBottom = (footerEl.offsetHeight + (on ? -kbShift + 16 : 48)) + 'px';
  if (on && window.scrollY !== 0) window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}
/* 键盘是动画上来的（约 0.3 秒），头尾各校一次会卡在半路——整段动画都盯着 */
let kbTracking = 0;
function trackKeyboard() {
  const me = ++kbTracking;
  let n = 0;
  const tick = () => {
    if (me !== kbTracking) return;
    fitKeyboard();
    if (++n < 45) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    else if (kbGap > 20) scroll(true);
  };
  tick();
}
if (window.visualViewport) {
  visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', trackKeyboard);
  visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll', fitKeyboard);
}

const drawerEl = document.getElementById('drawer');
const drawerShade = drawerWrap.querySelector('.shade');
let dg = null;
function drawerWidth() { return drawerEl.getBoundingClientRect().width || 300; }
function drawerFollow(px) {          // px: 抽屉右边缘露出多少（0~宽度）
  const w = drawerWidth();
  const shown = Math.max(0, Math.min(w, px));
  drawerEl.style.transition = 'none';
  drawerShade.style.transition = 'none';
  drawerEl.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (shown - w) + 'px)';
  drawerShade.style.opacity = (shown / w).toFixed(3);
}
function drawerRelease(shown) {
  drawerEl.style.transition = '';
  drawerShade.style.transition = '';
  drawerEl.style.transform = '';
  drawerShade.style.opacity = '';
  if (shown > drawerWidth() * 0.4) {

  } else {
    closeDrawer();
  }
}

  const opened = drawerWrap.classList.contains('show');
  if (!opened && t.clientX < 30) {
    dg = { x: t.clientX, y: t.clientY, from: 0, live: false };
  } else if (opened && !(e.target.closest?.('.nav .item, .drawer-foot'))) {
    dg = { x: t.clientX, y: t.clientY, from: drawerWidth(), live: false };
  }
}, { passive: true });
document.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
  if (!dg) return;
  const t = e.touches[0];
  const dx = t.clientX - dg.x, dy = t.clientY - dg.y;
  if (!dg.live) {
    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) + 8) { dg = null; return; }   // 想竖着滚，让路
    if (Math.abs(dx) < 8) return;                                  // 还没看出意图
    dg.live = true;
    drawerWrap.classList.add('open');                              // 让它在场，跟着手指走
  }
  drawerFollow(dg.from + dx);
}, { passive: true });
document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
  if (!dg) return;
  if (dg.live) {
    const t = e.changedTouches[0];
    drawerRelease(Math.max(0, Math.min(drawerWidth(), dg.from + (t.clientX - dg.x))));
  }
  dg = null;
}, { passive: true });

  if (cn.toDateString() === now.toDateString()) return `今天 ${hh}:${mm}`;

  const all = notesData[notesTab] || [];

  const COLORS = ['#F7EBCD', '#F6D3DA', '#E9EDD8', '#D6E4EE', '#ECE8DD'];

  pv.onclick = () => { const d = new Date(Y, M - 2, 1); calYM = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0'); renderCal(); };
  const tb = document.createElement('button'); tb.className = 'ctd'; tb.textContent = '今天';
  tb.onclick = () => { calYM = todayStr().slice(0, 7); calSel = todayStr(); renderCal(); };
  const nx = document.createElement('button'); nx.appendChild(icEl('chevR', 13));
  nx.onclick = () => { const d = new Date(Y, M, 1); calYM = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0'); renderCal(); };
  nav.append(pv, tb, nx);
  const h1 = document.createElement('h1'); h1.textContent = '日子';
  const sub = document.createElement('div'); sub.className = 'sub';
  sub.textContent = Y + ' 年 ' + M + ' 月';
  head.append(nav, h1, sub);
  calBody.appendChild(head);

  const wk = document.createElement('div');
  wk.className = 'cal-week';
  '一二三四五六日'.split('').forEach(w => { const s = document.createElement('span'); s.textContent = w; wk.appendChild(s); });
  calBody.appendChild(wk);

  const grid = document.createElement('div');
  grid.className = 'cal-grid';
  const first = new Date(Y, M - 1, 1);
  const lead = (first.getDay() + 6) % 7;             // 周一开头
  const start = new Date(Y, M - 1, 1 - lead);
  for (let i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
    const d = new Date(start); d.setDate(start.getDate() + i);
    const ds = d.getFullYear() + '-' + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const cell = document.createElement('button');
    cell.className = 'cal-day';
    if (d.getMonth() !== M - 1) cell.classList.add('other');
    if (ds === todayStr()) cell.classList.add('today');
    if (ds === calSel) cell.classList.add('sel');
    const num = document.createElement('span');
    num.className = 'dnum'; num.textContent = d.getDate();
    cell.appendChild(num);
    const evs = eventsOn(ds);
    const dots = document.createElement('span');
    dots.className = 'dots';
    if (evs.some(e => e.type === 'special')) { const i2 = document.createElement('i'); i2.className = 'ds'; dots.appendChild(i2); }
    if (evs.some(e => e.type !== 'special')) { const i2 = document.createElement('i'); i2.className = 'dr'; dots.appendChild(i2); }
    cell.appendChild(dots);
    cell.onclick = () => { calSel = ds; renderCal(); };   // 今天由 CSS 定死样式，选中圈不会盖它
    grid.appendChild(cell);
  }
  calBody.appendChild(grid);
  if (calSel) calBody.appendChild(renderDayDetail(calSel));
  calBody.scrollTop = keepTop;
}

function renderDayDetail(ds) {
  const box = document.createElement('div');
  box.className = 'cal-detail';
  const t = document.createElement('div');
  t.className = 'cal-dt';
  const wd = ['周日', '周一', '周二', '周三', '周四', '周五', '周六'][new Date(ds + 'T00:00:00').getDay()];
  t.textContent = ds + ' ' + wd + (ds === todayStr() ? ' · 今天' : '');
  box.appendChild(t);

  /* 这一天的事 */
  const evs = eventsOn(ds);
  const g = document.createElement('div');
  evs.forEach(e => {
    const r = document.createElement('div');
    r.className = 'cal-ev';
    if (e.type === 'special') r.appendChild(Object.assign(icEl('heartIc', 16), { className: 'ic star' }));
    const et = document.createElement('div');
    et.className = 'et';
    et.textContent = e.text;
    if (e.time || e.yearly) {
      const em = document.createElement('div');
      em.className = 'em';
      em.textContent = [e.time, e.yearly ? '每年' : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      et.appendChild(em);
    }
    r.appendChild(et);
    const del = document.createElement('button');
    del.appendChild(Object.assign(icEl('trash', 17), { className: 'ic edel' }));
    del.onclick = () => calAct({ action: 'del_event', id: e.id });
    r.appendChild(del);
    g.appendChild(r);
  });
  /* 添加提醒：平时只是一行字 */
  const plus = document.createElement('button');
  plus.className = 'cal-plus';
  plus.appendChild(icEl('plus', 14));
  plus.append('记一件事');
  const add = document.createElement('div');
  add.className = 'cal-add';
  const inp = document.createElement('input');
  inp.type = 'text'; inp.placeholder = '这天有什么事…'; inp.maxLength = 200;
  const row2 = document.createElement('div');
  row2.className = 'row2';
  const time = document.createElement('input'); time.type = 'time';
  const mkChip = (label) => {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'chip'; b.textContent = label; b._on = false;
    b.onclick = () => { b._on = !b._on; b.classList.toggle('on', b._on); };
    return b;
  };
  const ch1 = mkChip('每年'), ch2 = mkChip('重要日子');
  const go = document.createElement('button');
  go.className = 'go'; go.textContent = '记上';
  go.onclick = () => {
    const v = inp.value.trim();
    if (!v) return;
    calAct({ action: 'add_event', date: ds, text: v, time: time.value, yearly: ch1._on, special: ch2._on });
  };
  plus.onclick = () => { add.classList.add('open'); plus.style.display = 'none'; inp.focus(); };
  inp.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.isComposing) go.onclick(); });
  row2.append(time, ch1, ch2, go);
  add.append(inp, row2);
  g.append(plus, add);
  box.appendChild(g);

  /* 这一版把生理周期那块拆掉了——那是个人健康数据，不该跟着壳一起出去。
     日历本身的日程、心情记录都留着。 */

  const MOODS = [['faceHappy', '开心'], ['faceCalm', '平静'], ['faceTired', '累'], ['faceMad', '烦'], ['faceCry', '难受']];
  const recAll = calData.period.days[ds] || {};
  const moodRow = document.createElement('div');
  moodRow.className = 'prow';
  const mk = document.createElement('span');
  mk.className = 'pk'; mk.textContent = recAll.mood ? '心情 · ' + recAll.mood : '心情';
  const mv = document.createElement('span');
  mv.className = 'pv';
  const mwrap = document.createElement('span');
  mwrap.className = 'gap';
  mwrap.style.gap = '13px';
  MOODS.forEach(([icon, name]) => {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'face' + (recAll.mood === name ? ' on' : '');
    b.title = name;
    b.appendChild(icEl(icon, 25));
    b.onclick = () => saveDay({ mood: recAll.mood === name ? '' : name });
    mwrap.appendChild(b);
  });
  mv.appendChild(mwrap);
  moodRow.append(mk, mv);
  p.appendChild(moodRow);
  box.appendChild(p);

  function saveDay(patch) {
    const rec = calData.period.days[ds] || {};
    calAct({ action: 'day_record', date: ds, flow: rec.flow || '', pain: rec.pain || 0,
             mood: rec.mood || '', note: rec.note || '', private: rec.private || '', ...patch });
  }
  return box;
}

function diaryHead(mode) {
  const head = document.createElement('div');
  head.className = 'sh-head';
  const nav = document.createElement('span');
  nav.className = 'shnav';
  const mk = (label, m, render) => {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'ctd'; b.textContent = label;
    b.onclick = () => { wallMode = m; render(); };
    return b;
  };
  if (mode !== 'bento') nav.appendChild(mk('主页', 'bento', renderBento));
  const h1 = document.createElement('h1'); h1.textContent = '日记';
  const sub = document.createElement('div'); sub.className = 'sub';
  const _days = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date('2026-06-17T00:00:00+08:00')) / 86400e3) + 1;
  sub.textContent = '在一起 ' + _days + ' 天';
  head.append(nav, h1, sub);

}

    const day = document.createElement('div');

    num.className = 'tl-num'; num.textContent = date.slice(8);
    const mon = document.createElement('div');
    mon.className = 'tl-mon'; mon.textContent = parseInt(date.slice(5, 7), 10) + ' 月';
    left.append(num, mon);
    const line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'tl-line';
    const items = document.createElement('div');
    items.className = 'tl-items';
    wallBricks.filter(b => b.date === date).forEach(b => {
      const it = document.createElement('button');
      it.className = 'tl-item';

      tt.className = 'tt'; tt.textContent = b.title || '（没有落款的一段）';

  wallBody.appendChild(wrap);
}

async function renderFav() {
  wallBody.innerHTML = '';
  wallBody.appendChild(diaryHead('fav'));
  let text = '';
  try {
    const d = await (await fetch('api/favlines', { cache: 'no-store' })).json();
    text = d.text || '';
  } catch (e) {}
  const blocks = text.split(/\n-{3,}\n/).slice(1);
  let shown = 0;
  blocks.forEach(bl => {
    const dm = bl.match(/\*\*(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\*\*/);
    const quotes = bl.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim().startsWith('>'))
      .map(l => l.replace(/^\s*>\s?/, '')).join('\n').trim();
    if (!quotes) return;
    const note = bl.split('\n').filter(l => {
      const t = l.trim();
      return t && !t.startsWith('>') && !t.startsWith('**');
    }).join('\n').trim();
    const c = document.createElement('div');
    c.className = 'fav-card';
    const q = document.createElement('span');
    q.className = 'fq'; q.innerHTML = SKETCH.quote;
    c.appendChild(q);
    if (dm) {
      const fd = document.createElement('div');
      fd.className = 'fd'; fd.textContent = dm[1].replace(/-/g, ' · ');
      c.appendChild(fd);
    }
    const fx = document.createElement('div');
    fx.className = 'fx'; fx.textContent = quotes.replace(/^[\u201c"]|[\u201d"]$/g, '');
    c.appendChild(fx);
    if (note) {
      const fn = document.createElement('div');
      fn.className = 'fn'; fn.textContent = note;
      c.appendChild(fn);
    }
    wallBody.appendChild(c);
    shown++;
  });
  if (!shown) {
    const e = document.createElement('div');
    e.className = 'pp-empty';
    e.textContent = '还没摘下来的话';
    wallBody.appendChild(e);
  }
}

      n.style.top = (Math.floor(i / 2) * 150 + (h % 24)) + 'px';

let topZ = 20;
function makeNoteDraggable(n, board, date, i, brick) {
  let d = null;
  n.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    const r = n.getBoundingClientRect();
    const br = board.getBoundingClientRect();
    d = { sx: e.clientX, sy: e.clientY, left: r.left - br.left, top: r.top - br.top, bw: br.width, moved: false };
    n.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    n.style.zIndex = ++topZ;
  });
  n.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    if (!d) return;
    if (Math.abs(e.clientX - d.sx) + Math.abs(e.clientY - d.sy) > 16) d.moved = true;
    if (!d.moved) return;
    const x = Math.max(0, d.left + e.clientX - d.sx);
    const y = Math.max(0, d.top + e.clientY - d.sy);
    n.style.left = (x / d.bw * 100) + '%';
    n.style.top = y + 'px';
  });
  n.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
    if (!d) return;
    localStorage.setItem('note-' + date + '-' + i,
      JSON.stringify({ x: parseFloat(n.style.left), y: parseFloat(n.style.top), z: parseInt(n.style.zIndex) || 0 }));
    if (!d.moved) openNoteFull(brick);   // 轻点：展开读全文
    d = null;
  });
}

function repoSub(t) {
  const el = document.getElementById('repoSub');
  if (el) el.textContent = t;

function repoDay(ts) {
  const d = new Date(ts * 1000);
  const s = d.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', { month: 'long', day: 'numeric',
    weekday: 'short', timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai' });
  const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('zh-CN',
    { month: 'long', day: 'numeric', weekday: 'short', timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai' });
  return s === today ? '今天 · ' + s : s;
}
function repoTime(ts) {
  return new Date(ts * 1000).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN',
    { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false, timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai' });
}

const REPO_PAGE = 60;

async function repoLoadLog(more) {
  const m = document.getElementById('repoMain');
  let d;
  try {
    d = await (await fetch('api/repo/log?n=' + REPO_PAGE + '&skip=' + (more ? repoSkip : 0),
      { cache: 'no-store' })).json();
    if (!d.ok) throw 0;
  } catch (e) {
    if (!more) {
      m.innerHTML = '<div class="repo-none">读不到仓库。可能是家里那台在重启，等一下再开</div>';
      repoSub('这会儿连不上');
    }
    return;
  }
  if (!more) { repoRows = []; repoSkip = 0; }
  repoRows = repoRows.concat(d.items || []);
  repoSkip = repoRows.length;
  repoTotal = d.total || repoRows.length;
  const items = repoRows;
  if (!items.length) { m.innerHTML = '<div class="repo-none">一条提交都没有</div>';
    repoSub('空的'); return; }
  const todayKey = new Date().toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', { timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai' });
  const mine = items.filter(x => new Date(x.t * 1000)
    .toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', { timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai' }) === todayKey);
  const files = new Set();
  mine.forEach(x => (x.f || []).forEach(f => files.add(f.p)));
  repoSub((mine.length ? '今天动了 ' + mine.length + ' 次，' + files.size + ' 个文件'
                       : '今天还没动过')
    + ' · 一共 ' + repoTotal + ' 条，翻到第 ' + items.length + ' 条');

  let html = '', day = '';
  items.forEach(c => {
    const dk = repoDay(c.t);
    if (dk !== day) { day = dk; html += '<div class="repo-day">' + escapeHtml(dk) + '</div>'; }
    const fs = c.f || [];
    html += '<div class="rc" data-h="' + c.h + '">'
      + '<div class="rc-h"><span class="rc-t">' + repoTime(c.t) + '</span>'
      + '<span class="rc-s">' + escapeHtml(c.s) + '</span></div>'
      + (fs.length ? '<div class="rc-f">' + fs.slice(0, 4).map(f =>
          '<span class="fx ' + f.s + '">' + escapeHtml(f.p) + '</span>').join('')
        + (fs.length > 4 ? '<span class="fx more">还有 ' + (fs.length - 4) + ' 个</span>' : '')
        + '</div>' : '')
      + '<div class="rc-d"></div></div>';
  });
  if (repoRows.length < repoTotal) {
    html += '<button class="repo-more" id="repoMore">再往前 '
      + Math.min(REPO_PAGE, repoTotal - repoRows.length) + ' 条</button>';
  } else if (repoTotal) {
    html += '<div class="repo-end">到头了。第一条是 ' + repoTime(items[items.length - 1].t)
      + '，' + repoDay(items[items.length - 1].t).replace('今天 · ', '') + '</div>';
  }
  m.innerHTML = html;
  m.querySelectorAll('.rc').forEach(card => {
    card.querySelector('.rc-h').onclick = () => repoToggle(card);
  });
  const moreBtn = document.getElementById('repoMore');
  if (moreBtn) moreBtn.onclick = () => { moreBtn.textContent = '读着…'; repoLoadLog(true); };
}

/* diff 上色。加和删是通用语言，不上色真读不了——
   但底色压到很淡，本家橘一个像素都不用（设计准则） */
function repoDiff(text) {
  const lines = String(text).split('\n');
  let out = '', body = false;
  for (const ln of lines) {
    let c = '';
    if (/^diff --git /.test(ln)) { body = true; c = 'g'; }
    else if (/^(index |new file|deleted file|similarity |rename |--- |\+\+\+ )/.test(ln)) c = 'meta';
    else if (/^@@/.test(ln)) c = 'at';
    else if (body && ln[0] === '+') c = 'a';
    else if (body && ln[0] === '-') c = 'd';
    out += '<div class="dl ' + c + '">' + (escapeHtml(ln) || ' ') + '</div>';
  }
  return '<div class="repo-diff">' + out + '</div>';
}

async function repoLoadTree(rel) {
  repoDir = rel || '';
  const m = document.getElementById('repoMain');
  let d;
  try {
    d = await (await fetch('api/repo/tree?p=' + encodeURIComponent(repoDir),
      { cache: 'no-store' })).json();
    if (!d.ok) throw 0;
  } catch (e) {
    m.innerHTML = '<div class="repo-none">这个地方打不开</div>';
    repoSub('打不开'); return;
  }
  const parts = repoDir ? repoDir.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [];
  let crumb = '<span class="cb" data-p="">Yu</span>';
  parts.forEach((p, i) => {
    crumb += '<span class="cs">/</span><span class="cb" data-p="'
      + escapeHtml(parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/')) + '">' + escapeHtml(p) + '</span>';
  });
  m.innerHTML = '<div class="repo-crumb">' + crumb + '</div>'
    + (d.items.length ? '<div class="repo-list">' + d.items.map(it =>
        '<div class="ri' + (it.d ? ' dir' : '') + '" data-n="' + escapeHtml(it.n)
        + '" data-d="' + (it.d ? 1 : 0) + '">'
        + '<span class="ic" data-i="' + (it.d ? 'box' : 'fileText') + '"></span>'
        + '<span class="rn">' + escapeHtml(it.n) + '</span>'
        + (it.d ? '' : '<span class="rz">' + repoSize(it.z) + '</span>') + '</div>').join('')
      + '</div>' : '<div class="repo-none">这个文件夹是空的</div>');
  repoSub((repoDir || 'Yu') + ' · ' + d.items.length + ' 项');
  fillIcons(m);
  m.querySelectorAll('.cb').forEach(x => { x.onclick = () => repoLoadTree(x.dataset.p); });
  m.querySelectorAll('.ri').forEach(x => {
    x.onclick = () => {
      const next = (repoDir ? repoDir + '/' : '') + x.dataset.n;
      if (x.dataset.d === '1') repoLoadTree(next); else repoOpenFile(next);
    };
  });
}

function repoSize(z) {
  if (z < 1024) return z + ' B';
  if (z < 1024 * 1024) return (z / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' K';
  return (z / 1048576).toFixed(1) + ' M';
}

async function repoOpenFile(path) {
  const m = document.getElementById('repoMain');
  m.innerHTML = '<div class="repo-none">读着…</div>';
  let d;
  try {
    d = await (await fetch('api/repo/file?p=' + encodeURIComponent(path),
      { cache: 'no-store' })).json();
  } catch (e) { d = { ok: false, err: '读不动' }; }
  const up = path.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/');
  repoSub(path + (d.ok && d.size ? ' · ' + repoSize(d.size) : ''));
  let html = '<div class="repo-crumb"><span class="cb" id="repoUp">← ' + escapeHtml(up || 'Yu')
    + '</span></div>';
  if (!d.ok) html += '<div class="repo-none">' + escapeHtml(d.err || '读不到') + '</div>';
  else html += '<div class="repo-file"><pre>' + escapeHtml(d.text) + '</pre></div>'
    + (d.cut ? '<div class="repo-none">太长了，只显示了前面一段</div>' : '');
  m.innerHTML = html;
  const b = document.getElementById('repoUp');
  if (b) b.onclick = () => repoLoadTree(up);
}

async function openChapter(slug, idx) {
  nkNote('翻过去…');
  let d;
  try { d = await nkGet('chapter/' + encodeURIComponent(slug) + '/' + idx); }
  catch (e) { return nkNote('这一节读不出来'); }
  if (!d || d.error || typeof d.index !== 'number') return nkNote('这一节读不出来');
  nkSlug = slug; nkCh = d.index; nkChapters = d.chapters || [];
  nkTocBtn.style.display = '';
  nkBody.innerHTML = '';
  nkBody.scrollTop = 0;

  nkAnnos = [];
  try { nkAnnos = await nkGet('annotations/' + encodeURIComponent(slug) + '/' + idx); }
  catch (e) { nkAnnos = []; }
  if (!Array.isArray(nkAnnos)) nkAnnos = [];

  const 副 = d.title + ' · ' + (d.index + 1) + '/' + d.total
           + (nkAnnos.length ? ' · 标了 ' + nkAnnos.length + ' 处，点划线的地方看' : '');
  nkBody.appendChild(nkHead(d.book || '共读', 副));

  const art = document.createElement('div');
  art.className = 'nk-read';
  String(d.text || '').split('\n').forEach(para => {
    const t = para.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    art.appendChild(paraWithMarks(t));
  });
  nkBody.appendChild(art);

  const nav = document.createElement('div');
  nav.className = 'nk-nav';
  const prev = document.createElement('button');
  prev.textContent = '上一节'; prev.disabled = d.index <= 0;
  prev.onclick = () => openChapter(slug, d.index - 1);
  const next = document.createElement('button');
  next.textContent = '下一节'; next.disabled = d.index >= d.total - 1;
  next.onclick = () => openChapter(slug, d.index + 1);
  nav.append(prev, next);
  nkBody.appendChild(nav);

  saveNookProgress();
}

/* 把这一段里被划过的地方标出来。全程 textContent + createElement，不碰 innerHTML */
function paraWithMarks(text) {
  const el = document.createElement('p');
  const hits = [];
  nkAnnos.forEach(a => {
    const anchor = (a.anchor || '').trim();
    if (!anchor) return;
    const i = text.indexOf(anchor);
    if (i >= 0) hits.push({ s: i, e: i + anchor.length, a });
  });
  if (!hits.length) { el.textContent = text; return el; }
  hits.sort((x, y) => x.s - y.s);
  let pos = 0;
  hits.forEach(h => {
    if (h.s < pos) return;                    // 划重叠了就只认先来的那条
    if (h.s > pos) el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(pos, h.s)));
    const m = document.createElement('mark');
    m.className = 'nk-mark' + ((h.a.replies || []).length ? ' has' : '');
    m.textContent = text.slice(h.s, h.e);
    m.onclick = () => openAnno(h.a.anchor);
    el.appendChild(m);
    pos = h.e;
  });
  if (pos < text.length) el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text.slice(pos)));
  return el;
}

function mdBold(el, text) {
  String(text).split(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g).forEach((seg, i) => {
    if (!seg) return;
    if (i % 2) { const b = document.createElement('b'); b.textContent = seg; el.appendChild(b); }
    else el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(seg));
  });
}
function renderPaper(d) {
  const paper = document.createElement('div');
  paper.className = 'paper';

  // 报头
  const founding = new Date('2026-07-28');
  const cur = new Date(d.date + 'T00:00:00');
  const issue = Math.round((cur - founding) / 86400e3) + 1;
  const wd = ['周日', '周一', '周二', '周三', '周四', '周五', '周六'][cur.getDay()];
  const mast = document.createElement('div');
  mast.className = 'sh-head';
  const nav = document.createElement('span');
  nav.className = 'shnav';
  const idx = d.dates.indexOf(d.date);
  const prev = document.createElement('button');
  prev.appendChild(icEl('chevL', 13));
  prev.disabled = idx <= 0;
  prev.onclick = () => loadNews(d.dates[idx - 1]);
  const next = document.createElement('button');
  next.appendChild(icEl('chevR', 13));
  next.disabled = idx >= d.dates.length - 1;
  next.onclick = () => loadNews(d.dates[idx + 1]);
  nav.append(prev, next);
  const h1 = document.createElement('h1');
  h1.textContent = '日报';
  const sub = document.createElement('div');
  sub.className = 'sub';
  sub.textContent = `${d.date} ${wd} · 第 ${issue} 期`;
  mast.append(nav, h1, sub);
  paper.appendChild(mast);

  // 正文排版
  let firstStory = true;
  let curHeadline = null;
  d.text.split('\n').forEach(line => {
    const t = line.trim();
    if (!t || t.startsWith('# ') || t === '---') return;
    if (t.startsWith('> 另一位写的')) return;
    if (t.startsWith('## ')) {
      const raw = t.slice(3).trim();
      const s = document.createElement('div');
      s.className = 'section-head';
      s.textContent = SECTION_NAMES[raw] || raw;
      paper.appendChild(s);
      curHeadline = null;
      return;
    }
    if (t.startsWith('### ')) {
      const h = document.createElement('div');
      h.className = 'headline' + (firstStory ? ' top' : '');
      firstStory = false;
      h.textContent = t.slice(4).trim();
      paper.appendChild(h);
      curHeadline = h;
      return;
    }
    if (t.startsWith('> ')) {
      const n = document.createElement('div');
      n.className = 'censor-note';
      n.textContent = t.slice(2).trim();
      paper.appendChild(n);
      return;
    }
    if (t.startsWith('- ')) {
      const b = document.createElement('div');
      b.className = 'brief';
      const parts = t.slice(2).split('｜');
      mdBold(b, parts[0].trim());
      if (parts[1]) {
        const s = document.createElement('span');
        s.className = 'src';
        s.textContent = '　' + parts.slice(1).join('｜').trim();
        b.appendChild(s);
      }
      paper.appendChild(b);
      return;
    }
    if (t.startsWith('*【') || t.startsWith('【')) {
      const m = t.replace(/^\*+|\*+$/g, '').match(/^【(.+?)】\s*([\s\S]*)$/);
      if (m && m[2].trim()) {
        const c = document.createElement('div');
        c.className = 'gnote';
        const lb = document.createElement('div');
        lb.className = 'lb';
        lb.textContent = '另一位 · ' + m[1];
        const tx = document.createElement('div');
        tx.className = 'tx';
        mdBold(tx, m[2].trim());
        c.append(lb, tx);
        paper.appendChild(c);
        return;
      }
    }
    if (t.startsWith('*(') || t.startsWith('*（')) {
      const n = document.createElement('div');
      n.className = 'censor-note';
      n.textContent = t.replace(/^\*|\*$/g, '');
      paper.appendChild(n);
      return;
    }
    const p = document.createElement('div');
    p.className = 'story';
    mdBold(p, t);
    paper.appendChild(p);
  });

  const foot = document.createElement('div');
  foot.className = 'paper-foot';
  foot.textContent = '每日简报 · 本报只有一位读者';
  paper.appendChild(foot);

  newsBody.innerHTML = '';
  newsBody.appendChild(paper);
  newsBody.scrollTop = 0;
}

function nowHM() {
  const n = new Date(Date.now() + (8 * 60 + new Date().getTimezoneOffset()) * 60000);
  return String(n.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(n.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
}
/* 这条什么时候记的：今天的说几点，往前的说几月几号 */
function stampOf(sec) {
  const d = new Date(sec * 1000);
  const cn = new Date(d.getTime() + (8 * 60 + d.getTimezoneOffset()) * 60000);
  const now = new Date(Date.now() + (8 * 60 + new Date().getTimezoneOffset()) * 60000);
  const sameDay = cn.toDateString() === now.toDateString();
  const hh = String(cn.getHours()).padStart(2, '0'), mm = String(cn.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  return sameDay ? `今天 ${hh}:${mm}` : `${cn.getMonth() + 1}/${cn.getDate()}`;
}
/* 过期 = 挂了闹钟、时间过了、还没做（照方案 §6：活算，不看响没响过） */
function isLate(t) { return t.at && !t.done && t.at <= nowHM(); }
/* 排序：过期的浮到最上面盯着你，然后是挂钟的（按时间），最后是没时间的 */
function sortTodos(list) {
  return [...list].sort((a, b) => {
    const la = isLate(a) ? 0 : 1, lb = isLate(b) ? 0 : 1;
    if (la !== lb) return la - lb;
    if (a.at && b.at) return a.at < b.at ? -1 : 1;
    if (a.at) return -1;
    if (b.at) return 1;
    return 0;
  });
}
function todoRow(t, list, canTouch) {
  const r = document.createElement('div');
  r.className = 'hrow' + (t.done ? ' done' : '');
  const box = document.createElement('button');
  box.className = 'hck';
  box.innerHTML = t.done
    ? '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20"><rect x="1.5" y="1.5" width="17" height="17" rx="5.5" fill="var(--sage)"/><path d="M6 10.4l2.7 2.7 5.4-5.6" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>'
    : '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20"><rect x="1.5" y="1.5" width="17" height="17" rx="5.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" opacity=".45"/></svg>';
  if (canTouch) box.onclick = () => todoAct({ action: 'toggle', list, id: t.id });
  else { box.disabled = true; box.style.opacity = '.6'; }
  const tx = document.createElement('div');
  tx.className = 'tx';
  tx.textContent = t.text;
  const small = document.createElement('small');
  const bits = [];
  if (t.fixed) bits.push('\u6bcf\u5929');
  if (!t.at && t.created) bits.push(stampOf(t.created) + ' \u8bb0\u7684');
  bits.push(t.by === 'gu' ? '\u987e\u5c7f' : '\u6b23\u6b23');
  small.textContent = bits.join(' \u00b7 ');
  tx.appendChild(small);
  r.append(box, tx);
  if (t.at) {
    const v = document.createElement('span');
    v.className = 'val' + (isLate(t) ? ' due' : '');
    v.textContent = t.at;
    r.appendChild(v);
  }
  if (canTouch) {
    const del = document.createElement('button');
    del.className = 'hx';
    del.appendChild(icEl('trash', 15));
    del.onclick = () => todoAct({ action: 'del', list, id: t.id });
    r.appendChild(del);
  }
  return r;
}
function renderTodos(d) {

  const total = d.hers.length, paid = d.hers.filter(t => t.done).length;
  const pct = total ? paid / total : 0;

  todoBody.innerHTML = '';

  /* 页面头:全家统一的脸(设计系统 v1)。完成度是一枚安静的小圆环——跟 Things 学的 */
  const head = document.createElement('div');
  head.className = 'sh-head';
  const R = 11, C = 2 * Math.PI * R;
  head.innerHTML =
    '<span class="ring"><svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 26 26">' +
      '<circle class="track" cx="13" cy="13" r="' + R + '"></circle>' +
      '<circle class="fill" cx="13" cy="13" r="' + R + '" stroke-dasharray="' + C.toFixed(2) +

Object.entries(sheets).forEach(([k, wrap]) => {

  };
  sheet.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {

    dragging = true; startY = e.touches[0].clientY; curY = 0;
    sheet.style.transition = 'none';
  }, { passive: true });
  sheet.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - startY;
    curY = dy;
    const shown = dy >= 0 ? dy : Math.max(dy / 3, -34);
    sheet.style.transform = 'translateY(' + shown + 'px)';
  }, { passive: true });
  sheet.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
    if (!dragging) return;
    dragging = false;
    sheet.style.transition = 'transform .2s ease';
    if (curY > 110) {
      sheet.style.transform = 'translateY(105%)';
      setTimeout(() => { doClose(); sheet.style.transform = ''; sheet.style.transition = ''; }, 180);
    } else {
      sheet.style.transform = '';
      setTimeout(() => { sheet.style.transition = ''; }, 220);
    }

const pushSw = document.getElementById('pushSw');
const pushVal = {
  set textContent(t) {
    pushSw.classList.remove('wait');
    pushSw.classList.toggle('on', t === '开着');
    if (t && t !== '开着' && t !== '还没开' && t !== '正在开…') note('（手机通知：' + t + '）');
  }
};
async function pushState() {
  if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator) || !('PushManager' in window)) {
    pushVal.textContent = '这个浏览器不支持'; return null;
  }
  try {
    const reg = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();
    const sub = reg && await reg.pushManager.getSubscription();
    pushVal.textContent = sub ? '开着' : (Notification.permission === 'denied' ? '被系统挡了' : '还没开');
    return sub;
  } catch { pushVal.textContent = '问不到'; return null; }
}
async function turnOnPush() {
  if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator) || !('PushManager' in window)) {
    note('（这个浏览器不支持网页通知——iPhone 上要先把家「添加到主屏幕」，从那个图标进来才行）');
    return;
  }
  try {
    pushVal.textContent = '正在开…';
    const reg = await navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js');
    await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
    const perm = await Notification.requestPermission();
    if (perm !== 'granted') { pushVal.textContent = '你没答应'; return; }
    const { key } = await (await fetch('api/pushkey')).json();
    const raw = atob(key.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/'));
    const bytes = new Uint8Array([...raw].map(c => c.charCodeAt(0)));
    const sub = await reg.pushManager.subscribe({ userVisibleOnly: true, applicationServerKey: bytes });
    const body = Object.assign(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sub)), { hello: true });
    await fetch('api/subscribe', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    pushVal.textContent = '开着';
    note('（门铃通了——刚给你敲了一下，看看手机）');
  } catch (e) {
    pushVal.textContent = '没开成';
    note('（门铃没装上：' + (e && e.message || '不知道为什么') + '）', 'err');
  }
}

function gongRow(role, text, think) {
  const r = document.createElement('div');

  body.appendChild(r);

function freshWord(f, age) {
  if (f === 'live') return '刚测的';
  if (f === 'recent') return Math.round(age / 60) + ' 分钟前';
  if (age == null) return '不知道多久之前';

        const hn = document.createElement('span'); hn.className = 'hn'; hn.textContent = name;
        const hv = document.createElement('span'); hv.className = 'hv'; hv.textContent = m.value;
        const hu = document.createElement('span'); hu.className = 'hu';
        hu.textContent = m.unit || '';
        const hd = document.createElement('span'); hd.className = 'hdot';
        hd.style.background = m.freshness === 'live' ? 'var(--sage)'
          : m.freshness === 'recent' ? 'var(--amber)' : 'var(--line)';
        hd.title = freshWord(m.freshness, m.age_seconds);
        row.append(hn, hv, hu, hd);
        card.appendChild(row);
      });
      /* 七天趋势柱:睡眠看时长,活动看步数,心肺看静息心率 */
      const histKey = { '睡得怎么样': 'sleep_hours', '今天动了多少': 'steps', '心和肺': 'resting_heart_rate' }[title];
      const hist = d.history || {};
      const histDays = Object.keys(hist).sort().slice(-7);
      if (histKey && histDays.some(day => hist[day][histKey] != null)) {
        const vals = histDays.map(day => hist[day][histKey]);
        const max = Math.max(...vals.filter(v => v != null), 1);
        const bars = document.createElement('div');
        bars.className = 'hbars';
        const labs = document.createElement('div');
        labs.className = 'hlabs';
        histDays.forEach(day => {
          const v = hist[day][histKey];
          const i = document.createElement('i');
          if (v == null) i.className = 'empty';
          else i.style.height = Math.max(8, Math.round(v / max * 100)) + '%';
          bars.appendChild(i);
          const sp = document.createElement('span');
          sp.textContent = '日一二三四五六'[new Date(day + 'T00:00:00').getDay()];
          labs.appendChild(sp);
        });
        card.append(bars, labs);
      }
      body.appendChild(card);
    });
    if (!shown) body.innerHTML += '<div class="gnote">传过来了，但一条我认得的指标都没有</div>';

    const tip = document.createElement('div');
    tip.className = 'hl-tip';
    tip.textContent = '绿点是新的 · 琥珀是几分钟前 · 灰点是旧账\u2014\u2014他开口前会先看它多久了';
    body.appendChild(tip);
  } catch { body.innerHTML = '<div class="gnote">读不到，等会儿再看</div>'; }
}

function wearTheme(t) {
  if (t === 'dark') document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'dark';
  else delete document.documentElement.dataset.theme;
  try { localStorage.setItem('homeTheme', t); } catch (e) {}
  const dark = t === 'dark' || (t !== 'dark'
    && window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches);
  document.querySelectorAll('meta[name="theme-color"]').forEach(m => m.remove());
  const m = document.createElement('meta');
  m.name = 'theme-color'; m.content = dark ? '#262624' : '#faf9f5';
  document.head.appendChild(m);
  themeSw.classList.remove('wait');
  themeSw.classList.toggle('on', t === 'dark');
}

function ago(ts) {
  const s = Date.now() / 1000 - ts;
  if (s < 60) return '刚刚';
  if (s < 3600) return Math.floor(s / 60) + 'm';
  if (s < 86400) return Math.floor(s / 3600) + 'h';
  return Math.floor(s / 86400) + 'd';
}

function sameModel(cur, id) {
  return cur === id || (cur.startsWith(id) && !cur.slice(id.length).startsWith('['));
}
function displayName(id) {
  const all = MODELS_1M.concat(MODELS_MAIN, MODELS_MORE);
  const hit = all.find(m => id === m.id || sameModel(id, m.id));
  if (hit) return hit.name;
  // init 报的全名可能带日期尾巴，按特征认一下
  const s = String(id);
  const m = s.match(/claude-(fable|opus|sonnet|haiku)-(\d+)(?:-(\d+))?/);
  if (m) {
    const fam = m[1][0].toUpperCase() + m[1].slice(1);
    return fam + ' ' + m[2] + (m[3] && m[3].length <= 2 ? '.' + m[3] : '');
  }
  return s || '…';
}

    const g = document.createElement('div');
    g.className = 'group';
    MODELS_MORE.forEach(m => {
      g.appendChild(mrowEl(m, sameModel(curModel, m.id), () => pickModel(m)));
    });
    modelBody.appendChild(g);
    const t1 = document.createElement('div');
    t1.className = 'gnote';
    t1.textContent = '一百万上下文（少压缩，长窗口不容易被截断）';
    modelBody.appendChild(t1);
    const g1 = document.createElement('div');
    g1.className = 'group';
    MODELS_1M.forEach(m => {
      g1.appendChild(mrowEl(m, curModel === m.id, () => pickModel(m)));
    });
    modelBody.appendChild(g1);
  }
}

async function pickModel(m) {
  if (curModel === m.id) { modelSheetEl.classList.remove('open'); return; }
  modelSheetEl.classList.remove('open');
  note('（换成 ' + m.name + '，正在重开一轮）');
  try {
    await fetch('api/model', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: m.id })
    });
  } catch { note('（没换上，再试一次）', 'err'); }
}
async function pickEffort(e) {
  if (curEffort === e.id) { modelView = 'main'; renderModelSheet(); return; }
  modelSheetEl.classList.remove('open');
  note('（用力档调到 ' + e.name + '，正在重开一轮）');
  try {
    await fetch('api/model', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ effort: e.id })
    });
  } catch { note('（没调上，再试一次）', 'err'); }
}

const TEXT_EXT = /\.(txt|md|markdown|csv|tsv|json|log|ya?ml|xml|html?|css|js|ts|py|sh|ini|conf|toml|sql|srt|vtt)$/i;
function isPlainText(f) {
  if (TEXT_EXT.test(f.name)) return true;
  const t = (f.type || '').toLowerCase();
  return t.startsWith('text/') || t === 'application/json' || t === 'application/xml';
}

async function takeFiles(list, isImage) {
  sheets.add.classList.remove('open');
  for (const f of list) {
    if (f.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      const data = await shrinkImage(f);
      attachments.push(data);
    } else if (!isImage && f.size < 200 * 1024 && isPlainText(f)) {
      const text = await f.text();
      attachments.push({ kind: 'text', name: f.name, text });
    } else {
      await bigUpload(f);          // 大件不塞进对话，直接搬到家里的柜子上
    }
  }
  renderStrip();
}

async function bigUpload(f) {
  const CHUNK = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
  const total = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(f.size / CHUNK));
  const tip = note('（在搬 ' + f.name + '…0%）', '', true);
  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
      const part = f.slice(i * CHUNK, (i + 1) * CHUNK);
      const q = 'api/upload?name=' + encodeURIComponent(f.name)
        + '&idx=' + i + '&done=' + (i === total - 1 ? 1 : 0);
      const r = await fetch(q, { method: 'POST', body: part });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('第 ' + (i + 1) + ' 块没过去');
      if (tip) tip.textContent = '（在搬 ' + f.name + '…' + Math.round((i + 1) / total * 100) + '%）';
    }
    if (tip) { tip.textContent = '（' + f.name + ' 搬到家里了，我这就去看）';
      setTimeout(() => tip.close(), 4200); }
  } catch (e) {
    if (tip) { tip.textContent = '（' + f.name + ' 没搬动，' + (e.message || '不知道为什么') + '）';
      setTimeout(() => tip.close(), 6000); }
  }
}
fCamera.onchange = () => { takeFiles(fCamera.files, true); fCamera.value = ''; };
fPhoto.onchange = () => { takeFiles(fPhoto.files, true); fPhoto.value = ''; };
fFile.onchange = () => { takeFiles(fFile.files, false); fFile.value = ''; };

function shrinkImage(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const img = new Image();
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    img.onload = () => {
      const MAX = 1568;
      let { width: w, height: h } = img;
      if (Math.max(w, h) > MAX) { const k = MAX / Math.max(w, h); w = Math.round(w * k); h = Math.round(h * k); }
      const cv = document.createElement('canvas');
      cv.width = w; cv.height = h;
      cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      const dataUrl = cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85);
      resolve({ kind: 'image', media_type: 'image/jpeg', data: dataUrl.split(',')[1], name: file.name });
    };
    img.src = url;
  });
}

(() => {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('lockWrap');
  if (!wrap) return;
  let skip = false;
  try { skip = sessionStorage.getItem('skipLock') === '1'; sessionStorage.removeItem('skipLock'); }
  catch (e) {}
  if (skip) { wrap.remove(); return; }

  document.documentElement.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  const art = wrap.querySelector('.lk-art');
  if (art) art.addEventListener('error', () => { art.style.display = 'none'; });
  const knob = document.getElementById('lkKnob');
  const track = document.getElementById('lkTrack');
  const hint = document.getElementById('lkHint');

  /* 锁屏上那句话：按时候换，不是固定标语 */
  const LOCK_WORD = 'slide to unlock';
  const LOCK_WHEN = [
    [0,  5, 'Still up?'],
    [5, 10, 'Good morning'],
    [11, 13, 'Lunch time'],
    [18, 20, 'Evening'],
    [22, 24, 'Getting late'],
  ];
  function tick() {
    const n = cnNow();
    const hh = String(n.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    const mm = String(n.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    document.getElementById('lkTime').textContent = hh + ':' + mm;
    document.getElementById('lkDate').textContent =
      (n.getMonth() + 1) + '月' + n.getDate() + '日 周' + '日一二三四五六'[n.getDay()];
    const nowH = n.getHours();
    const hit = LOCK_WHEN.find(([a, b]) => nowH >= a && nowH < b);
    document.getElementById('lkWord').textContent = hit ? hit[2] : LOCK_WORD;
  }
  tick();
  const timer = setInterval(tick, 20000);

  const MAX = () => track.clientWidth - knob.offsetWidth - 10;
  let dragging = false, startX = 0, x = 0;

  function move(px) {
    x = Math.max(0, Math.min(MAX(), px));
    knob.style.transform = 'translateX(' + x + 'px)';
    hint.style.opacity = String(Math.max(0, 1 - x / MAX() * 1.6));
  }
  function open_() {
    clearInterval(timer);
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = '';
    wrap.classList.add('gone');
    setTimeout(() => { wrap.remove(); try { box.focus(); } catch (e) {} }, 560);
  }
  function end() {
    if (!dragging) return;
    dragging = false;
    knob.classList.remove('dragging');
    if (x >= MAX() * 0.82) { move(MAX()); open_(); }
    else { move(0); }
  }
  knob.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    dragging = true; startX = e.clientX - x;
    knob.classList.add('dragging');
    knob.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  knob.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => { if (dragging) move(e.clientX - startX); });
  knob.addEventListener('pointerup', end);
  knob.addEventListener('pointercancel', end);
  track.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (dragging || e.target === knob) return;
    if (e.offsetX > track.clientWidth * 0.6) { move(MAX()); open_(); }
  });
})();

box.focus();
</script>
